narr: The combination of a stationary dryline and strong instability produced isolated severe thunderstorms across the Big Country and Concho Valley. The storms produce large hail and strong wind gusts. Also, localized flash flooding was reported in San Angelo due to torrential rainfall in a short period of time.
ev: Law Enforcement reports numerous roads and intersections under water in San Angelo.
